name: zero_delta_zero_output
description: delta=0 across all positions forces A_bar=exp(0)=1 and B_bar=0*B=0, so h stays at h_0=0 indefinitely and y=C*0=0. Boundary fixture proving the kernel handles the zero-input edge correctly.
derivation: A_bar = exp(delta_t * A_d) = exp(0 * A_d) = exp(0) = 1.0 (for all t). B_bar = delta_t * B_t = 0 * B_t = 0 (for all t). h_t = 1.0 * h_{t-1} + 0 * x_t = h_{t-1}. Since h_0 = 0, h stays 0 forever. y_t = C_t * 0 = 0.
